HEADING directory-structure: Directory Structure
Scenarios are grouped by split and CARLA town (Town01–Town05, Town10HD). In the anomaly test split, scenarios are additionally grouped by anomaly type (e.g. change-weather, vanish-actor).
carlanomaly/
├── train/
│   ├── Town01/
│   │   ├── scenario-1/
│   │   └── ...
│   └── ...
└── test/
    ├── normal/
    │   ├── Town01/
    │   │   ├── scenario-1/
    │   │   └── ...
    │   └── ...
    └── anomaly/
        ├── Town01/
        │   ├── <anomaly-type>/
        │   │   ├── scenario-1/
        │   │   └── ...
        │   └── ...
